2608.27484.title: CareGraph: An Auditable Hybrid AI Framework for Evidence-Grounded Personalized Longitudinal Health Intelligence
2608.27484.paper_summary: Artificial intelligence is transforming personalized healthcare, yet fragmented clinical, self reported, and wearable evidence remains difficult to interpret and trace. We present CareGraph, an auditable hybrid AI framework that converts heterogeneous records into prioritized trends, missing context indicators, bounded next steps, discussion questions, and provenance linked explanations. CareGraph organizes evidence without diagnosing, predicting outcomes, selecting treatment, or making autonomous clinical decisions. Its pipeline covers deterministic analysis, context detection, graph construction, constrained language model synthesis, evidence validation, safety controls, and release gating. Tests used synthetic cohorts of 400 patients each for development, validation, and holdout. On holdout data, a frozen ordinary least squares trend rule with a sufficiency gate achieved 0.827 accuracy, 0.837 macro F1 with a 95 percent confidence interval of 0.819 to 0.854, and 0.974 insufficient data F1. Missing context detection achieved 0.815 strict micro F1 versus 0.318 for the legacy detector. On an authored holdout benchmark, safety ruleset version 1.2 achieved 1.000 precision, 0.950 recall, and 0.974 F1. An audit requiring graph retrieval across 80 patients yielded 79 syntheses and 78 presentations without fallback; one output was blocked and one failed closed because of an invalid evidence key. Against monolithic GPT 5.6 on 56 matched patients, CareGraph was faster at 40.15 versus 49.62 seconds, shorter at 661 versus 1,163 words, and showed better exploratory lexical alignment with longitudinal targets; the baseline used fewer tokens and cited more raw evidence. Graph auditing verified provenance and deterministic retrieval; incremental graph effects on generation require paired evaluation. CareGraph offers a safety bounded foundation for intelligent personalized health systems.
2608.27484.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧正在改變個人化醫療，但分散的臨床、自我報告和可穿戴證據仍然難以解釋和追蹤。我們提出了 CareGraph，一個可審計的混合 AI 框架，將異質記錄轉換為優先趨勢、缺失的上下文指標、有限的下一步、討論問題和來源連結的解釋。CareGraph 組織證據而不進行診斷、預測結果、選擇治療或做出自主臨床決策。其流程涵蓋確定性分析、上下文檢測、圖形構建、受限語言模型合成、證據驗證、安全控制和發布閘道。測試使用了每組 400 名患者的合成隊列進行開發、驗證和保留。在保留數據上，一個凍結的普通最小二乘趨勢規則與充分性閘道達到了 0.827 的準確率，0.837 的宏 F1，95% 的置信區間為 0.819 至 0.854，以及 0.974 的不足數據 F1。缺失上下文檢測達到了 0.815 的嚴格微 F1，而舊檢測器為 0.318。在一個作者保留的基準上，安全規則集版本 1.2 達到了 1.000 的精確率，0.950 的召回率和 0.974 的 F1。一次需要在 80 名患者中檢索圖形的審計產生了 79 次合成和 78 次展示，沒有回退；一個輸出被阻止，另一個因為無效的證據鍵而失敗關閉。與 56 名匹配患者的單體 GPT 5.6 相比，CareGraph 在 40.15 秒的速度上更快，而 49.62 秒則較慢，字數上為 661 與 1,163，並且在與縱向目標的探索性詞彙對齊上表現更好；基線使用了更少的標記並引用了更多的原始證據。圖形審計驗證了來源和確定性檢索；生成上的增量圖形效果需要配對評估。CareGraph 為智能個人健康系統提供了一個安全的基礎。
2608.27484.author: Pratik Ghawate et.al.
